summary: End-to-end verification of the new Gaming module. 12/12 pytest backend tests pass against the preview backend (auth gates, home shape with 17 games + 7 sellers, list, detail, reliability+price ordered offers, sellers, search, negative cases 400/404/401, purchase→expense creation, gaming/summary, DELETE cascades to expenses). Playwright frontend flow passes: sidebar 'Gaming' link (nav-gaming-link) present between AI Asistan and Ev, /gaming hub renders header 'Ne satın almak istiyorsun?', search input, today deals panel, monthly panel, all 4 section tabs (popular/cheapest/campaigns/instant), 17 game tiles, 7 seller cards, catalog note. Search 'valorant' returns game + 4 products. Valorant detail lists products, product detail shows offers sorted by reliability then price with row 1 highlighted 'En uygun'. 'Satın al' opens the seller URL in a new tab (bynogame.com/kategori/valorant confirmed) and the gaming-confirm-modal appears. Clicking 'Satın aldım' posts to /api/gaming/purchases, closes modal, shows success toast; /expenses page then contains a Gaming expense; /gaming monthly total reflects updated ₺550 / 2 satın alma.

issues: Console shows repeated 400 errors while navigating between pages (likely unrelated preflight/log endpoint or an unmatched /api call); not blocking Gaming flow but worth investigating in a future pass.

critical_code_review_comments: gaming_catalog.py `_product_ids` in build_catalog uses `list(products_by_id.values())` inside the game loop, which iterates ALL products (including those from prior games) every time. Correct today because filter by game_slug removes cross-game entries, but O(N*M) — small refactor could collect per-game ids directly during the inner loop.
routers/gaming.py uses a global `_CATALOG_CACHE`; if catalog is ever mutated at runtime this could leak state. For now it's a pure dict built once — fine, just document.
GamingPurchaseCreate has no validation that `date` is actually YYYY-MM-DD (only length 10). A regex/date parser would harden it, but not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Test creates one gaming purchase (Valorant 475 VP @ ByNoGame, ₺105) and deletes it in the cascade test. One residual purchase from prior manual QA (₺445) is present under demo account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_gaming.py hard-codes REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL fallback to the preview URL because cookies set by /api/auth/login are Secure and cannot be replayed against http://localhost:8001; keep using the public preview URL for auth-required backend tests. pytest.ini enforces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`, so a session/module-scoped login fixture works only if all tests in the same module land on one worker (loadscope guarantees that).
